description: Single source of truth for WHO may authorize an order. Risk limits live in config/portfolio_policy.json and are enforced by the deterministic Risk Gate in every mode. Broker writes are a separate switch: LIVE requires AGENTIC_LIVE_ORDER_PLACEMENT=true; PAPER always writes to the simulated PaperBroker.

modes.OBSERVE: Discover, research, decide and risk-check. Proposals are journaled; no order is ever created.
modes.HUMAN_APPROVAL: Every order waits for a human APPROVE on the dashboard.
modes.AUTONOMOUS: The deterministic OrderAuthority authorizes orders that pass every check below. Anything else is escalated to the human approval queue.

autonomous_notes.allowed_actions: Order types the policy may authorize without a human.
autonomous_notes.required_risk_verdict: Only a clean Risk Gate PASS is auto-authorized; REQUIRES_ENHANCED_REVIEW / HALTED go to a human.
autonomous_notes.max_orders_per_day: Broker submissions per ET trading day (all origins) before further orders escalate.
autonomous_notes.max_buy_notional_pct_nav_per_day: Cumulative BUY/ADD notional per day as % of NAV.
autonomous_notes.max_single_order_pct_nav: Largest single BUY/ADD as % of NAV.
autonomous_notes.min_cash_reserve_pct_nav: Cash that must remain after a BUY/ADD.
autonomous_notes.max_spread_bps: Send-time bid/ask spread ceiling (wider spreads defer the order).
autonomous_notes.min_minutes_after_open / min_minutes_bef: Send window inside the regular session.
autonomous_notes.max_consecutive_execution_failures: Broker-side failures in a row that trip the kill switch.
autonomous_notes.authorization_ttl_hours: An autonomous authorization is valid for the first session it can execute in; this is an extra backstop.
